scope: Targeted narrative architecture comparison, not exhaustive systematic review

CSDI Conditional Score-based Diffusion Models Probabilistic Time Series Imputation NeurIPS 2021 paper
CorrDiff generative diffusion residual regression kilometer scale atmospheric downscaling Nature Medicine 2024

search_note: Exploratory query wording is recorded verbatim; publication metadata is taken from primary pages and Crossref, not query assumptions.
retrieval_notes: CorrDiff Nature page initially inaccessible; arXiv v4 methods retrieved and DOI identity verified via Crossref.
GenCast Nature page retrieved; Appendix D read from arXiv v2; online/print dates distinguished.
Some OpenReview/PMC pages challenged access; original conference PDF and arXiv full text used.
Search-result citations and secondary reading lists were discovery leads, not mechanism evidence.

sources.title: Autoregressive Denoising Diffusion Models for Multivariate Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
sources.verified_mechanism: RNN conditions a multivariate diffusion emission at each physical time; autoregressive rollout.
sources.transfer_boundary: Original training uses target sequence history; hidden GNSS target histories remain excluded.

sources.title: CSDI: Conditional Score-based Diffusion Models for Probabilistic Time Series Imputation
sources.passages: Sections 4.2-4.3, Section 5 two-dimensional attention and side information
sources.transfer_boundary: Replace feature-index semantics with coordinates; distinguish imputation masks from physical causal masks.

sources.title: Transformer-Modulated Diffusion Models for Probabilistic Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
sources.verified_mechanism: Transformer prediction enters prior and both forward/reverse processes.
sources.transfer_boundary: Cannot move only a conditional forward mean without its consistent reverse process.

sources.title: Residual corrective diffusion modeling for km-scale atmospheric downscaling
sources.passages: Preprint v4 Sections 5.2.1-5.2.2 and 5.3.2; publication identity checked via Crossref
sources.verified_mechanism: Regression mean followed by conditional residual EDM.
sources.transfer_boundary: Dense regional-model labels differ from sparse GNSS station residual labels.

sources.title: Probabilistic weather forecasting with machine learning
sources.passages: Autoregressive state generation; methods Appendix D normalized changes and conditional graph transformer
sources.verified_mechanism: Next-state diffusion conditioned on previous two states; normalized changes and recursive ensemble trajectories.
sources.transfer_boundary: Weather-state increments differ from errors relative to a frozen GNSS foundation field.

sources.title: Diffusion-based Time Series Imputation and Forecasting with Structured State Space Models
sources.venue: TMLR; exact publication-year metadata not harmonized in this note
sources.passages: Section 2.4 and implementation appendix C; bidirectional S4 context
sources.verified_mechanism: Structured state-space layers in conditional diffusion for long sequences and missingness.
sources.transfer_boundary: Original imputation configuration is bidirectional; online use needs causal adaptation.

sources.title: Diffusion-TS: Interpretable Diffusion for General Time Series Generation
sources.passages: Sections 3.2-3.4 trend/season/error decomposition, sample reconstruction and Fourier loss
sources.verified_mechanism: Decomposition transformer with x0 reconstruction and spectral objective.
sources.transfer_boundary: Spectral fit alone does not establish useful hourly increments or causal forecasting.

sources.title: Score-based Data Assimilation
sources.passages: Abstract and Section 1 observation model and trajectory posterior; original PDF retrieved
sources.verified_mechanism: Separate trajectory prior and noisy observation model, observation guidance at inference.
sources.transfer_boundary: Already conditioned generators require checking observation double counting.
